title: Content associations with answer selection and engagement in supply chain community question answering
abstract: arXiv:2610.21807v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Community question-answering platforms are important ecosystems for knowledge sharing, yet research on what makes an answer best or a question engaging has often focused on either individual lexical features or broad topics. This exploratory study examines both levels in Yahoo! Chiebukuro, asking which nouns and semantic noun clusters are associated with best-answer selection and question engagement. We analyze a large corpus of questions and answer-tier posts collected under the keyword logistics, using an offline machine-translation pipeline with manually validated noun-level fidelity. Best-answer selection is modeled with conditional logistic regression within question threads, controlling for answer length, order, and question-answer noun overlap. translated_title: 供应链社区问答中内容特征与答案选择及用户参与度的关联
translated_abstract: 社区问答平台是知识共享的重要生态系统，然而关于何种因素使答案成为最佳答案、或使问题引发用户参与的研究，往往只关注单个词汇特征或宽泛的主题。这项探索性研究在Yahoo! Chiebukuro（雅虎知惠袋）上同时考察了这两个层面，探究哪些名词及语义名词聚类与最佳答案选择及问题参与度相关。我们分析了以“物流”为关键词收集的大型问题及答案层级帖子语料库，采用离线机器翻译流程，并对名词层面的翻译保真度进行了人工验证。最佳答案的选择采用问题线程内的条件逻辑回归建模，并控制了答案长度、答案顺序以及问题与答案之间的名词重叠。参与度则通过两阶段模型进行建模：一是问题是否收到任何回复，二是在收到回复的条件下，该问题吸引了多少条回复。诸如“分拨”等操作性物流名词……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究基于雅虎知惠袋“物流”关键词的问答语料，运用条件逻辑回归与两阶段参与度模型，揭示了具体名词及其语义聚类与最佳答案选择和问题参与度之间的关联。
en_tdlr: Analyzing a Yahoo! Chiebukuro logistics Q&A corpus with conditional logistic regression and two-stage engagement models, this study links specific nouns and semantic noun clusters to best-answer selection and question engagement.
